a_reason: Chosen primitive three-cycle phase, not a fitted physical constant or spatial rotation
main_memory_rule: independent fresh registers; two clocks and a path probe at the same event share that register
memory_counterprotocol: reuse one register for all three links, with no reset or intermediate measurement

universal coupling to the sum of probe charges
initial plus states and two-quadrature readout

universal_clock_boundary: For all sufficiently small clock charges, exact fractional phase rate is common only at p=0, 1/2, 1. At p=1/2, the connected readable band is |a*q|<pi. Generic p gives only a low-charge approximation.
